thesis_invalidators.invalidating_print: A subsequent medical-cost-ratio miss, a Q3 pre-announcement, or any management commentary showing utilization trending worse than the 'returning to form' language from the Q2 call would kill this thesis outright.
thesis_invalidators.invalidating_structure: A decisive daily close back below the 200-week moving average (~$437.56) on rising volume, or a close below the 50-DMA, would show the reversal has failed.
thesis_invalidators.time_box: If UNH has not sustained a close above $460 (continuation toward the old 52-week-high zone) within 30 trading days of entry, exit and rotate -- the post-earnings gap needs volume-confirmed continuation, not just a one-day pop.
